correctness_confidence.basis: Fully backed by 0-sorry Lean 4 proofs and AST-audited exact rational Python verifications across all 16 canonical certificates, covering exact matrix factorizations, vertex/facet enumerations, and quantitative rational bounds.

novelty.basis: First machine-checked formal verification and exhaustive zero-float certification of the disproof of the long-standing 2013 Dagstuhl conjecture on polytope extension complexity subadditivity.

reproducibility.basis: Complete public repository archive with deterministic build scripts (lake build), exact rational Python verifier, pytest suite, and MANIFEST.sha256 hashing.

rigor.basis: Exceptional mathematical and formal rigor; 18 constructive theorems verified in Lean 4 without custom axioms or choice, accompanied by exhaustive test suites (34 tests including adversarial forgery checks).

significance.basis: Resolves a fundamental question in polyhedral combinatorics and extension complexity, establishing definitive counterexamples and unbounded deficit scaling.

strengths: Complete 0-sorry, 0-axiom, 0-choice Lean 4 verification of 18 constructive theorems.
Exhaustive zero-float Python verifier operating strictly over Python int and fractions.Fraction.
Comprehensive test suite covering 16 canonical certificates and 16 adversarial forgery checks.
Definitive confirmation of polytope extension complexity non-additivity under Cartesian products.
strong_novelty_candidates: First machine-checked formal verification of polytope extension complexity non-additivity.
Zero-float rational certification framework for large-scale matrix nonnegative rank factorizations and polytope vertex lifts.
summary: The manuscript presents an exemplary formal verification and zero-float certificate suite (XC-NONADD-CERT-1.0) auditing Minhao Liu's disproof of the polytope extension complexity subadditivity conjecture. With 0-sorry Lean 4 proofs, 16 verified canonical certificates, and rigorous adversarial tests, the work is exceptionally thorough, rigorous, and reproducible.
weaknesses: Highly specialized domain requires fluency in polyhedral combinatorics and formal theorem proving to fully appreciate every low-level arithmetic identity.
